observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: competition stage under a tent with wooden floor and green background visible through clear walls
observation.dancers: group of three women wearing competitor numbers
observation.formation_and_space: line formation facing forward, performing in place
observation.posture: upright erect torso, slightly turned out legs, weight predominantly on the balls of the feet
observation.footwork: springing and pointing feet, alternating extension of one leg while hopping or springing on the supporting leg in place
observation.arms_and_hands: hands on hips or arms raised overhead with curved elbows and fingers almost touching
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and stable while legs move with high extension
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent vertical jumps and springing hops, high leg extensions, no floor work
observation.costume_and_props: dark fitted jackets with white trimming, plaid kilts, matching patterned knee-high socks, ghillies (dance shoes), competitor numbers pinned to kilts
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placements and precise weight transfer details obscured by distance and low frame rate

signature_moments.what: dancers jump with arms raised overhead and extend one leg to the side, then switch legs on the beat
hands on hips while performing rapid hopping turns and leg extensions with pointed toes
arms raised in fifth position while extending and pointing the working leg low to the side in rapid succession
